_about: Inputs and pre-registered rules of step C: WISER common-mode error across tags and pairwise-distance precision, cohort 2026c (wiser/scripts/analyze_wiser_common_mode.py; plan implementation_plan/2026-10-03-wiser-common-mode.md, approved by the user 2026-10-03 as step C of A -> B -> C). Periods, animals, exclusions, certified still segments (primary, >= 30 s, 1 s trimmed at both ends) and their truths are the failure audit's (audit_run / audit_config), used unchanged. Thresholds of the verdict are the plan's. Operational choices and their amendments are listed in the plan. A new cohort = a new copy of this file + a re-run.

grid._note: residual grid = integer seconds of the IMU-aligned clock (t_al_ms); a 1-s value is the coordinate-wise median of the method's fixes in [g - 0.5 s, g + 0.5 s) (>= 2 fixes), a 10-s value the median in [g - 5 s, g + 5 s) (>= 10 fixes, as the audit's 10-s drift); every window lies wholly inside the segment's trimmed span

anchors._note: anchors_list = the anchors listed for the fix (a superset of the anchors used: anchors_used <= n_list in every fix). Reference set of a segment = anchors listed in >= ref_share of its fixes; an anchor of the reference set is lost in a second when it is listed in < lost_share of that second's fixes. Secondary: anchors_used, low = 1-s mean < low_used_lt.

shared_excursion._note: pair-seconds where both tags' raw 10-s residual magnitudes are >= min_in (the audit's crazy-drift size); runs within a pair overlap = events; events of all pairs overlapping in time (gap <= merge_gap_s) = clusters
